title: Mondelez International - Kraft Foods Corporate Office
address:

Coral Gables, Florida 33134

description:
This project built out a multi-floor corporate office interior for Mondelez International at 396 Alhambra Circle in Coral Gables, with custom touches like bifold and specialty glass openings, including skyline-facing installations on the upper floors.

Mondelez keeps its global headquarters in Chicago, but this 15,600-square-foot space in the North Tower served as the regional hub for its Latin American operations.
